test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Discern"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Discern"** is only correctly spelt word.
 
• The word **"Discern"** means to difficultly distinguish or recognize as separate and distinct
 
 
• **Example: **It is difficult to **discern** any pattern in these figures.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us see the correct spellings and meaning of other options too.

 
• **Harass: **To trouble or threaten someone by doing unpleasant to them.

 
 
• **Example: **The was being **harassed** by her husband since ten years.
 
 
 
• **Repercussions**: A resultant activity, consequence.
 
 
• **Example: **The **repercussions** of increased pollution is alarming day by day.
 
 
 
• **Appealing:** Something attractive or interesting.
 
 
• **Example:** Her attire for the ceremony was very **appealing**.
